key: CHIEF: So! You're giving chase after all!
en: CHIEF: So! You're giving chase after all!
ja: チーフ: なんと! やっぱり追ってきたか!

key: Of course you would!
en: Of course you would!
ja: そりゃそうだよな!

key: CHIEF: So, they sent you after me!
en: CHIEF: So, they sent you after me!
ja: チーフ: つまり、お前を差し向けてきたわけか!

key: I had a feeling that this little heist might end up with you and I facing off!
en: I had a feeling that this little heist might end up with you and I facing off!
ja: この一件、いずれお前とオレが対決することになる気はしてたんだ!

key: After all that, no less...
en: After all that, no less...
ja: それも、あれだけのことがあった後にな……

key: I should've known as much after our little chat in Train Town.
en: I should've known as much after our little chat in Train Town.
ja: トレインタウンでのちょっとした会話の後、こうなるのは分かってたはずだ。

key: A confrontation between us was inevitable, perhaps.
en: A confrontation between us was inevitable, perhaps.
ja: オレたちの対決は、避けられなかったのかもな。

key: After all, it's only to be expected in the wake of--
en: After all, it's only to be expected in the wake of--
ja: なにしろ、こうなった後じゃ当然のことだ――

key: CORIN-ROUGE: Corin-Rouge, the dashing rogue!
en: CORIN-ROUGE: Corin-Rouge, the dashing rogue!
ja: コリン・ルージュ: 華麗なる怪盗、コリン・ルージュ推参!

key: Beautiful mistress, my heart soars to see you again!
en: Beautiful mistress, my heart soars to see you again!
ja: 麗しき淑女よ、再びまみえて我が心は舞い上がる!

key: But imagine my surprise, fair lady!
en: But imagine my surprise, fair lady!
ja: しかし、麗しき人よ、この驚きを想像してくれ!

key: I undertook this quest to steal the orbs-- but a fool I was!
en: I undertook this quest to steal the orbs-- but a fool I was!
ja: オーブを盗まんとこの企てに挑んだが――なんと愚かだったことか!

key: For the real treasure I would steal would be but a glance at your beauty!
en: For the real treasure I would steal would be but a glance at your beauty!
ja: 我が真に盗むべき宝は、あなたの美しさへのひと目にほかならなかったとは!

key: How long has it been but to look upon a face so angelic, and feel the thrill...
en: How long has it been but to look upon a face so angelic, and feel the thrill...
ja: かくも天使のごとき顔を見つめ、この胸の高鳴りを感じるのは、いつ以来であったか……

key: The adrenaline of the eternal cat and mouse-- the tango you and I share-- the sleuth and her swindler!
en: The adrenaline of the eternal cat and mouse-- the tango you and I share-- the sleuth and her swindler!
ja: 永遠の追いかけっこがもたらすアドレナリン――あなたと我とのタンゴ――探偵とペテン師の踊り!

key: And at the end of it, you've brains to match beauty!
en: And at the end of it, you've brains to match beauty!
ja: そして最後には、美貌に見合う知略まで見せつけてくれるとは!

key: Truly, you are a flower to which no spring can compare!
en: Truly, you are a flower to which no spring can compare!
ja: まことに、あなたはいかなる春の花にも勝る一輪よ!

key: But alas-- I have been undone, embarrassed even!
en: But alas-- I have been undone, embarrassed even!
ja: だが悲しいかな――我は敗れ、恥までかいてしまった!

key: As my plans were unravelled by my very own partner in crime!
en: As my plans were unravelled by my very own partner in crime!
ja: よもや我が計画が、己の相棒によって崩されるとは!

key: How could this have happened, and such a dazzling star be painted at the center of it instead?!
en: How could this have happened, and such a dazzling star be painted at the center of it instead?!
ja: こんなことがあり得ようか、それもかくもまばゆき星がその中心に描かれるとは!

key: And you fought hard, to be sure!
en: And you fought hard, to be sure!
ja: それに、あなたは確かによく戦った!

key: But to overtake a lady is simply the nature of a man such as I!
en: But to overtake a lady is simply the nature of a man such as I!
ja: だが淑女を出し抜くのは、我のような男の性というものよ!

key: It makes the swinging even sweeter!
en: It makes the swinging even sweeter!
ja: それがこの振り子をより甘美なものにする!

key: For you, my crowning treasure, I shall illuminate the events that have transpired that we may both appreciate!
en: For you, my crowning treasure, I shall illuminate the events that have transpired that we may both appreciate!
ja: 我が至宝たるあなたのために、起こったことの一部始終を明らかにしよう、共に味わえるようにな!

key: You did well to seek me out in the end!
en: You did well to seek me out in the end!
ja: 最後にはこうして我を見つけ出すとは、あっぱれだ!

key: What should have been a carefully-laid plan was unraveled all too quickly...
en: What should have been a carefully-laid plan was unraveled all too quickly...
ja: 綿密に練られたはずの計画は、あまりにもあっけなく崩れてしまった……

key: It seems a wrench was thrown into my plans by my very own ally,
en: It seems a wrench was thrown into my plans by my very own ally,
ja: どうやら、我が計画に横やりを入れたのは、我が身内の仲間であったようだ、

key: And you chanced to come upon it!
en: And you chanced to come upon it!
ja: そして、あなたは偶然それに出くわしたというわけだ!

key: It seems this time, as ever, I was but one step ahead!
en: It seems this time, as ever, I was but one step ahead!
ja: 今回もまた、我は一歩先を行っていたようだな!

key: You see my friend beside me!
en: You see my friend beside me!
ja: ご覧の通り、我が友がここに!

key: I'm sure with all of the recent happenstances, this needs no explanation.
en: I'm sure with all of the recent happenstances, this needs no explanation.
ja: 昨今の出来事を思えば、説明の必要もあるまい。

key: It was divine providence, or something close enough, that this friend happened to open a portal into my cell within the jail!
en: It was divine providence, or something close enough, that this friend happened to open a portal into my cell within the jail!
ja: この友がたまたま獄中の我が独房へと通じる穴を開けてくれたのは、神の采配、あるいはそれに近い何かであった!

key: By pure chance, this little one interjected itself into one of my heists...
en: By pure chance, this little one interjected itself into one of my heists...
ja: まったくの偶然から、このちびが我が盗みの一つに割り込んできて……

key: And as you can imagine, we have been fast friends ever since!
en: And as you can imagine, we have been fast friends ever since!
ja: ご想像の通り、それ以来ずっと固い友情で結ばれているというわけだ!

key: The plan this time was not so complex...
en: The plan this time was not so complex...
ja: 今回の計画は、さほど複雑なものではなかった……

key: As soon as I caught wind of the orbs' discovery I began following the trail of information.
en: As soon as I caught wind of the orbs' discovery I began following the trail of information.
ja: オーブ発見のうわさを耳にするや否や、我はその情報の足跡を追い始めた。

key: My investigation was detected, and the chief changed the shipment to an earlier train, so I knew I had to act fast.
en: My investigation was detected, and the chief changed the shipment to an earlier train, so I knew I had to act fast.
ja: 我の調査は気づかれ、チーフは輸送を早めの列車に変更した。ゆえに、素早く動かねばならぬと悟った。

key: I sent out an invitation to the six individuals you interviewed-- each who might have stolen it for their own purposes.
en: I sent out an invitation to the six individuals you interviewed-- each who might have stolen it for their own purposes.
ja: あなたが話を聞いた六人に招待状を送った――それぞれ、己の目的でオーブを盗みかねぬ者たちだ。

key: Just as intended, they each tried.
en: Just as intended, they each tried.
ja: 狙い通り、それぞれが試みた。

key: But as ever-- I was miles ahead.
en: But as ever-- I was miles ahead.
ja: だが常のごとく――我ははるか先を行っていた。

key: My friend here did the heavy lifting.
en: My friend here did the heavy lifting.
ja: 力仕事をこなしてくれたのは、ここにいる我が友だ。

key: A few torn circuits at the front of the train...
en: A few torn circuits at the front of the train...
ja: 列車の先頭で回路をいくつか断ち切り……

key: Warp to the back as the lights go out...
en: Warp to the back as the lights go out...
ja: 灯りが消えると同時に後方へワープ……

key: Back to the front and hide the orbs away in the engine compartment...
en: Back to the front and hide the orbs away in the engine compartment...
ja: そして先頭へと戻り、オーブを機関室に隠す……

key: The Blue Orb in particular will be priceless for the citizens of Train Town.
en: The Blue Orb in particular will be priceless for the citizens of Train Town.
ja: 特にブルーオーブは、トレインタウンの住民たちにとって値の付けようもない代物となろう。

key: If we can simply learn to control its properties as a water source, they'll never need to worry again.
en: If we can simply learn to control its properties as a water source, they'll never need to worry again.
ja: それを水源として制御する術さえ会得できれば、彼らはもう何も案じる必要がなくなる。

key: ...But it seems my friend here decided to have a bit of fun, and snuck it into your bag instead.
en: ...But it seems my friend here decided to have a bit of fun, and snuck it into your bag instead.
ja: ……だが、我が友はどうやら少々悪ふざけを決め込み、代わりにあなたのかばんへと忍び込ませてしまったようだ。

key: CORIN-ROUGE: ...It's not the first time it's done that.
en: CORIN-ROUGE: ...It's not the first time it's done that.
ja: コリン・ルージュ: ……こいつがそれをやるのは、これが初めてじゃない。

key: It seems to think it's funny.
en: It seems to think it's funny.
ja: 面白いと思っているようでな。

key: I can't say with confidence that it's wrong.
en: I can't say with confidence that it's wrong.
ja: 間違っているとも、自信を持っては言えんが。

key: Nevertheless!
en: Nevertheless!
ja: とはいえ!

key: We've chatted long enough, have we not?
en: We've chatted long enough, have we not?
ja: 語らいはもう十分だろう?

key: Though it pains me to cut our darling time short,
en: Though it pains me to cut our darling time short,
ja: この愛おしい時間を切り上げるのは心苦しいが、

key: I have a getaway to make yet.
en: I have a getaway to make yet.
ja: 我にはまだ、逃げ延びる仕事が残っている。

key: Rather than running, however, I think I prefer our odds standing and fighting.
en: Rather than running, however, I think I prefer our odds standing and fighting.
ja: だが逃げるより、堂々と戦って勝負する方が性に合っているようだ。

key: Me and my friend together against your beauty...
en: Me and my friend together against your beauty...
ja: 我と我が友、二人であなたの美しさに挑もう……

key: Me and my friend together against your power...
en: Me and my friend together against your power...
ja: 我と我が友、二人であなたの力に挑もう……

key: Who do you think will come out on top?
en: Who do you think will come out on top?
ja: さて、勝つのはどちらだと思う?

key: It seems luck wasn't on my side this time after all.
en: It seems luck wasn't on my side this time after all.
ja: 今回ばかりは、運が我に味方しなかったようだ。

key: Haaaaa?!
en: Haaaaa?!
ja: ハァァァ!?

key: CORIN-ROUGE: So... Even our tag team is no match for the elegant graces of a valkyrie such as you!
en: CORIN-ROUGE: So... Even our tag team is no match for the elegant graces of a valkyrie such as you!
ja: コリン・ルージュ: なんと……我らのタッグをもってしても、あなたのような戦乙女の優雅さには敵わぬか!

key: Very well, my lady!
en: Very well, my lady!
ja: よろしい、我が淑女よ!

key: You leave me with no choice, but to...
en: You leave me with no choice, but to...
ja: こうなっては、我に残された道はただ一つ……

key: CORIN-ROUGE: So, even this was not enough...
en: CORIN-ROUGE: So, even this was not enough...
ja: コリン・ルージュ: これでも、まだ足りなかったか……

key: Then there is only one thing left to do...
en: Then there is only one thing left to do...
ja: ならば、なすべきことはただ一つ……

key: ...Run!
en: ...Run!
ja: ……逃げるのみ!

key: TERRA: Just leave me.
en: TERRA: Just leave me.
ja: テラ: 放っておいて。

key: I'm sure you were doing something before I interrupted.
en: I'm sure you were doing something before I interrupted.
ja: あたしが邪魔する前、何かやってたんでしょ。

key: I don't need to be a part of this story anymore.
en: I don't need to be a part of this story anymore.
ja: もうこの話に、あたしが加わる必要はないから。

key: TERRA: STOP!!!!
en: TERRA: STOP!!!!
ja: テラ: やめて!!!!

key: TERRA: hammer time
en: TERRA: hammer time
ja: テラ: ハンマータイム

key: ooooh, wait, is that--
en: ooooh, wait, is that--
ja: おおっと、待って、それって――

key: shoot, i didn't mean to send HIM over here.
en: shoot, i didn't mean to send HIM over here.
ja: しまった、あいつをここに送るつもりじゃなかったのに。

key: that's not a friend--
en: that's not a friend--
ja: あれは味方じゃない――

key: SO sorry about that little mix up
en: SO sorry about that little mix up
ja: ちょっとした行き違い、ホントごめんね。

key: our staff will get that cleaned up right away!
en: our staff will get that cleaned up right away!
ja: スタッフがすぐに片付けますので!

key: here, let's just--
en: here, let's just--
ja: ほら、こうやって――

key: we'll make that go away.
en: we'll make that go away.
ja: これで、なかったことにしちゃおう。

key: that's better!
en: that's better!
ja: うん、これでよし!

key: now just forget you ever saw anything, okay?
en: now just forget you ever saw anything, okay?
ja: 今見たこと、もう忘れてね?

key: the real one is juuuuuuuust ahead!
en: the real one is juuuuuuuust ahead!
ja: ホンモノはこの先すぐだから!

key: ANNA: \PN, I found you!
en: ANNA: \PN, I found you!
ja: アンナ: \PN、見つけた!

key: I think I'm starting to get a handle on things!
en: I think I'm starting to get a handle on things!
ja: だんだん状況がつかめてきた気がする!

key: I'm at least able to keep a handle on myself in here...
en: I'm at least able to keep a handle on myself in here...
ja: 少なくとも、ここでは自分を保てるようになってきた……

key: I still don't know know where I am, though.
en: I still don't know know where I am, though.
ja: でも、自分がどこにいるのかは、まだ分からないままだけど。

key: The New World is so big, yet so... empty.
en: The New World is so big, yet so... empty.
ja: ニューワールドはとても広いのに……どこかからっぽ。

key: The infinite void is really making it hard for me to focus...
en: The infinite void is really making it hard for me to focus...
ja: この果てしない虚無のせいで、なかなか集中できなくて……

key: But... that's okay!
en: But... that's okay!
ja: でも……大丈夫!

key: I've found more friends!
en: I've found more friends!
ja: 仲間もまた見つかったし!

key: Cain is here, but, well... he won't wake up.
en: Cain is here, but, well... he won't wake up.
ja: カインもここにいるんだけど、その……目を覚まさないの。

key: There... surely must be something I can do...
en: There... surely must be something I can do...
ja: きっと……あたしにできることがあるはず……

key: But!
en: But!
ja: でも!

key: It's okay!
en: It's okay!
ja: 大丈夫!

key: You can help me!
en: You can help me!
ja: あなたなら手伝ってくれるよね!

key: I can sense someone ahead of a portal that Hoopa opened near you!
en: I can sense someone ahead of a portal that Hoopa opened near you!
ja: フーパがあなたの近くに開いたポータルの先に、誰かの気配を感じるの!

key: I'll... I'll figure this out!
en: I'll... I'll figure this out!
ja: あたし……あたし、なんとかしてみせる!

key: I'm sure I can figure this out...
en: I'm sure I can figure this out...
ja: きっと、なんとかできるはず……

key: For now, though... I'm counting on you!
en: For now, though... I'm counting on you!
ja: でも今は……あなたを頼りにしてる!

key: Help me save everyone, \PN!
en: Help me save everyone, \PN!
ja: \PN、みんなを助けるのを手伝って!
